items.title: Pure signatureTag candidate-derivation leaf + source type
items.context: New pure leaf (e.g. core/signature-candidate.ts) importing only node:/types: deriveSignatureCandidate(category, files, desc) -> a deterministic canonical-ish tag (category + coarse fileKind + a normalized desc key; lowercase, stopword-stripped, capped). Add a SignatureTagSource type ('auto' | 'confirmed') to the finding/types. No I/O in the leaf.
items.userSees: A deterministic function that turns a finding's category/files/desc into a fallback candidate signatureTag.
excludes: No claim of human-quality signatures (it is a fallback)

items.title: Wire auto-candidate + source flag into finding_add (audit-only)
items.context: In handlers/finding.ts finding_add: if a non-empty signatureTag is supplied, persist it with signatureTagSource='confirmed'; otherwise derive a candidate via deriveSignatureCandidate and persist it with signatureTagSource='auto'. Both signatureTag and signatureTagSource MUST be excluded from the finding _hash / signFinding (mirror the existing signatureTag exclusion) and from every gate and the finding signature. Optionally fold the candidate through resolveTag for alias canonicalization. Keep the existing reviewer-supplied behavior byte-identical when a tag is given.
items.userSees: Every new finding carries a signatureTag (confirmed if the reviewer set one, else an auto fallback) plus a source flag; the finding _hash is unchanged.
excludes: No change to the finding _hash / signFinding output
No gate reads the new fields
No change when a reviewer supplies a tag (other than recording source=confirmed)

items.title: Smoke + npm script + verifier (incl. _hash invariance)
items.context: New smoke: deriveSignatureCandidate is deterministic + sane on representative inputs; finding_add with no tag yields signatureTagSource='auto' + a non-empty candidate, with a tag yields 'confirmed' + the supplied tag; and CRITICALLY the finding _hash/signature is byte-identical with vs without the new fields (no gate perturbation). npm script + committed verifier (build + this smoke + no-regression + full npm test incl. process-fact-contract; static checks that signatureTag/signatureTagSource are excluded from signFinding/_hash). Maps every intent; TOTAL/PASS/FAIL.
items.userSees: npm smoke passes and the verifier prints PASS, including the _hash-invariance check.
excludes: No reliance on unrelated repo state
